Senses.Explanation: Xu Six carrying a board is the stock picture of one-sided vision: the board blocks one side while its bearer sees only the other. Named commentators apply the verdict to paired answers, lineage figures, and students trapped by either sound-and-form or purity. It is a criticism of partial seeing, not a biography of Xu Six.

Senses.Explanation: Fond of the child, one fails to see the ugliness turns parental partiality into a Chan appraisal. Speakers apply it when a founder, teacher, or commentator protects, prolongs, or explains a move so fondly that its fault is no longer faced without favor. Chonghua Neng applies it to Shakyamuni’s flower and pairs it with a separate cutting verdict on Mahakasyapa’s smile. Dahui Zonggao builds it into a departure verse; Tianyin Yuanxiu uses it on Mazu’s further examination of Baizhang. Juelang Daosheng names his own exhaustive explanation with the phrase, while Feiyin Tongrong explicitly tells the assembly not to classify their present meeting that way.

Occurrences.Kwic: 掩室、毗耶杜詞，斯皆理為神御，故口以之而默，豈曰無辨？辨所不能言也。如天不言，靡所不蓋；如地不言，靡所不載。故曰，天無私蓋、地無私載。天若私，則有蓋、有不蓋；地若私，則有載、有不載。古人所謂：皇天無二道，聖人無兩心。雖無二道，昆蟲草木咸植其中，隨其根性悉遂其生。故《法華經》云：『密雲彌布，一雨普滋。』斯非法喻齊彰、佛天無二者乎？」遂舉拂云：「有眼者見。」復敲香几云：「有耳者聞。聞見分明，是個甚麼？」擲拂云：「正恁麼時，諸人分上又作麼生？還委悉麼？一氣不言含有象，萬靈悉稟共同根。」下座。追嚴請上堂，僧問：「析肉還母，析骨還父，父母非我親，誰是最親者？」師云：「眼中著屑。」進云：「千江有水千江月，一道寒光亙古今」師云：「錯認定盤星。」問：「大事未明，如喪考妣，是如何？」師云：「萬仞峰頭獨足立。」「大事已明，如喪考妣，是如何？」師云：「千山萬山獨行去。」僧禮拜，師乃云：「生死去來全體現，陰間陽世絕行蹤。」驀拈拄杖指云：「杖頭指著金剛體，汝毋回光證舊容。」喝一喝，云：「還見麼？」卓拄杖下座。上堂。「纔然五月念九，又是七月初一，可謂日月如梭、光陰迅速，諸人還得個休歇也未？若得個休歇，便見釋迦老子道：『我能促一劫如半日，延半日如一劫。』趙州亦云

ActorAttribution.GrammarEvidence: 僧問 assigns 析肉還母，析骨還父 to the unnamed monk's question; 師云 begins Miyun Yuanwu's response afterward.

Senses.Explanation: The paternal half of the Nezha dismemberment formula: he returns bones to father and flesh to mother before manifesting a complete body and speaking for them. Yulin Tongxiu uses the expression through direct raising of the complete Nezha formula. Miyun Yuanwu independently deploys it through independent recorded-sayings use.

Senses.PreferredTarget: an elbow does not bend outward
Senses.Note: The source preserves a longer form ending with ‘bend’; the queued headword is its searchable core.

Occurrences.Kwic: 逼人。朗云：『仕官千日，失在一朝。』爛泥裏有刺。傅拂袖便行，見機而作。明招云：『朗上座喫了招慶飯，外邊去打野榸。』忍俊不禁。朗云：『和尚又作麼生？』任伊起倒？招云：『非人得其便。』肐膊不向外曲，賊過後張弓。雪竇蹋倒茶爐，又作麼生？將謂有多少奇特。即如雪竇頌云：『來問若成風，應機非善巧。堪悲獨眼龍，曾未呈牙爪。』一似不許他古人，瞎瞎。不見道：當斷不斷，反招其亂。」澗梅舉
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J33/J33nB294.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Liangting Ting of Yunxi (雲溪俍亭挺禪師語錄). Speaker: Liangting Jingting.

Senses.Explanation: Liangting Jingting comments that an elbow does not bend outward: loyalties and reflexes incline toward one’s own side. The comment follows Mingzhao’s reply and is immediately paired with ‘drawing the bow after the thief has passed’: the arm turns toward its own side, while the second proverb mocks action taken too late.
